  and persists regardless of aggregate convergence trends. New title direction: ''Aggregate
  Metrics Hide Architecture-Specific Behavior in Hybrid Language Models.'' Lead claim

  different subsets of examples — standard evaluation is blind to this. Convergence

  architecture selection matters even when leaderboard scores converge, because failure
  modes don''t overlap → ensemble/routing potential. Trade-off: weaker theoretical
  story, but more defensible claims.

  '
